INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

3. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1: Functional Writing: Shopping List and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
